subject: Field kit routing and brand ambassador schedules for Redwood pavilion
messages:
From: Sasha Reynolds <sasha@confhub.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Field kit routing & BA schedules for Redwood Pavilion

Hey Markus —

Quick intro — I am coordinating freight windows and on-site Brand Ambassador (BA) check-ins for the Redwood pavilion at CloudCon. Attached is the preliminary field kit manifest (fieldkit_manifest_v1.pdf). We need to lock the: 

- inbound crate drop window (preferred)
- BA shift coverage matrix (day/night shows)
- single-point contact for on-site sign pick-up

Can you confirm:
1) preferred dock slot (AM/PM) for crates to avoid peak traffic
2) how many ambassadors we are rostering each day (and when they arrive for briefing)
3) any fragile/locked items that need escorted unloading

Victor from Fleet Courier is on the thread to coordinate ETA once you confirm the window.

Thanks — Sasha
Sasha Reynolds
Event Operations Manager
ConfHub
Attachment: fieldkit_manifest_v1.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Reynolds <sasha@confhub.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Victor Chen <victor@fleetcourier.io>
Date: Thu, 29 Jun 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Field kit routing & BA schedules for Redwood Pavilion

Thanks Sasha —

Plan proposal (high level):
- Dock window: prefer 07:00–09:30 AM on show load-in day (keeps us ahead of afternoon traffic). If the venue forces PM, we can flip but will need extra unloading crew.
- BA coverage: target 6 ambassadors on showfloor during open hours (split into two 4.5-hr shifts). 2 ambassadors per shift for the demo pod, 4 roaming. Briefing on the morning of Day 1 at 08:00 (30 min).
- Fragile items: two demo A/V racks and the interactive kiosk crate marked ``fragile/escort required''. Will need a floor escort during unload and to the booth.

Laura — can you confirm collateral counts (swag + one-pagers) against the attached sample list and drop the Drive link? Logan — can you confirm a small escort team (2 people) for crate unload during AM window?

Markus Klein
Manager, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Markus —

Confirmed collateral counts against marketing's packing list:
- Swag: 1,500 stickers, 800 postcards, 600 t-shirts (mix S–XL), 300 tote bags
- Paper collateral: 1,000 one-pagers, 300 datasheets, 200 case studies
- Demo units: 3 laptops (in protective cases) + 1 touchscreen kiosk

I've uploaded the finalized sample pack list and a print-ready art folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCxyzFieldKitDocs
Attachment: sample_pack_list.xlsx

Notes: t-shirts should be boxed separately and labeled by size; kiosks are powered and boxed with foam inserts — those are the fragile items Markus flagged.

Laura Bennett
Senior Events Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Reynolds <sasha@confhub.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Victor Chen <victor@fleetcourier.io>
Date: Fri, 05 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Field kit routing & BA schedules for Redwood Pavilion

All set on my end. Final ops details:

- Dock slot confirmed: 07:30–09:00 AM, Load-in Day (Window approved by venue)
- Crate numbers: 6 total 
  - CR-1001 (interactive kiosk) — fragile, escort required
  - CR-1002 (A/V rack) — fragile, escort required
  - CR-1003 through CR-1006 (swag + collateral)
- Pickup for press/backwall signage: Venue storage to hold kits until 09:15; Markus or nominated rep to collect from storage desk.
- Courier contact: Victor Chen (Fleet Courier) will stage at 07:00 at Gate B and ETA to dock at 07:25. Victor — please verify your pickup routing (HS-12345).

Quick checklist for the BA team:
- Day 1 briefing: 08:00 in meeting room B (Markus to lead)
- Radios: 4 chargers and 6 radios in CR-1003
- Emergency spare shirts: 50 packed in CR-1004

If anyone needs me on site earlier for crate inspection I can be there by 06:30. Attached crate manifest for carrier (crate_manifest_12.pdf).

Logan Wright
Logistics Coordinator, Events Ops
Redwood Inference
